name: Default
description: The stock character. Every core trait at the engine's own default weight, carrying the one stock quirk: it already reaches for damage. This is what every fight was fought with before personalities existed — edit it to move ALL enemies, or author a sibling to move one.

name: Aggressive
description: Fights forward. Cares far more about the damage it can project than about what it loses doing so, and taps units freely. Its Captain is a body like any other. STARTING POINT — never playtested.

name: Defensive
description: Plays to keep what it has. Fears losing units and being worn down, holds formation, and hoards its taps — it drops the damage quirk entirely, so it only ever attacks because attacking happened to be the safest thing to do. STARTING POINT — never playtested.

name: Board-oriented
description: Wants the richest battlefield: fields everything, buffs what stands, and treats an unspent hand as the real defeat. Reads as relentless rather than reckless — it still fears dying at the stock rate. STARTING POINT — never playtested.
